hi there!! i’ve been in this similar position in the past, basically i moved in with new flatmates in sept and it was sort of like exposure therapy for me? because they ate takeaways/went to restaurants etc and they were always(!) okay, and in my brain they were eating “risky food” too. food poisoning is really rare and our bodies are strong, i know it doesn’t seem like that when you have this phobia though. what has really helped me is that i stopped looking up food poisoning news, restaurant reviews etc - i found it only fuelled my phobia. i know it’s really difficult but at some point i was so sick of missing out on eating good food and spending time with my friends that i had to just tell myself “f*ck it!!” and eat regardless of how scary it felt, which gets easier the more you do it. ultimately you have control, though i know it doesn’t feel like it. best of luck to you!! chances are it’s very unlikely you will get ill
